title: Nonsharp p-isocapacitary Penrose inequality with a nonempty connected minimal boundary, vanishing relative H2 and the stated level-gradient decay
author: Luca Benatti; Mattia Fogagnolo; Lorenzo Mazzieri
work: Nonlinear Isocapacitary Concepts of Mass in 3-Manifolds with Nonnegative Scalar Curvature
source_version: Official SIGMA 19 (2023) article 091, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2023.091; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof develops weak monotonicity of two nonlinear p-Hawking quantities and compares their common asymptotic limit to the volume-capacity mass. It regularizes the p-capacitary equation, passes second-derivative terms distributionally through critical sets, and controls the residual terms by weak Sobolev convergence and dominated convergence. The comparison uses a two-sign asymptotic subsequence argument and combines both monotonic quantities to obtain the precise nonsharp coefficient (5-p)/2.

source_check.note: Selected scope is exactly inequality(1.5) for nonempty smooth compact connected minimal boundary. M is a smooth connected complete noncompact one-ended Riemannian3-manifold, 1<p<3, strongly p-nonparabolic, scalar curvature nonnegative, relative H2(M,boundaryM;Z)=0 and the exact displayed condition(dagger) on the level-gradient integral. All new Lemmas3.1–3.2 and AppendixA monotonicity/regularization proofs are included. Existing p-harmonic regularity, the published regularized differential inequality and the standard generalized l-Hospital criterion are background; the author supplies the new critical-set/distribution convergence and mass comparison. The boundary-free positivity and Euclidean rigidity portions are excluded: their source uses Gp once and log Gp subsequently and finishes rigidity by a prior calculation. No source change or new boundary-free proof is supplied. Source approval supplied only by exact frozen root input; no new source/difficulty decision or mathematical referee.
